title: A turn reveals another decision
meaning: Change can help you understand a shared intention anew when flexible action meets willingness to hear an important realisation.
text: An unexpected turn can clarify why you began acting in the first place. The Wheel of Fortune in the physical position of Manipura describes adapting your steps as conditions shift. The Wheel of Fortune in energy identifies the wish to find an opening within change and keep moving. Judgement in emotions brings a significant realisation: the original idea suddenly speaks differently. These are distinct roles, changing the method, wanting to use the turn and experiencing a fresh understanding. Changed circumstances alone establish no obligation to begin everything again.

For example, you intend to print a large photo album, but the chosen format is temporarily unavailable. While seeking another option, you realise that regularly collecting small stories matters more than producing one imposing volume. **A new method helps when it clarifies your shared intention.** You can choose a compact edition and begin with one theme. The turn remains an external difficulty, while discussion helps you find a form that feels alive and shared.

The difficulty appears if every change is declared a definitive sign of a new path. A powerful realisation then triggers a complete revision before anything takes shape. The meaning of each fresh turn absorbs you, leaving fewer stable agreements between you. Insight benefits from a concrete next action and enough time for you both to discover what has actually changed.
